_readme: Starter content for the AAYKAY theme. Imported once into WordPress when the theme is first activated
(or from Tools > AAYKAY starter content). After that, WordPress is the source of truth: edit content in
the dashboard, not here. Re-importing only adds items whose slug or name is missing; it never overwrites.
Project fields: slug, name, sector (a key from 'sectors'), location, area_sqft (whole number or null),
floors, order_value, design_team, status ('Ongoing' / 'Completed' / 'Completed YYYY' or null), note, source (internal),
featured (null, or the homepage card: order, label, image, alt, details 'Label: value' lines, note).
Client 'logo' is a file bundled in the theme (SVG allowed); logos added later are uploaded in WordPress.
Leave a field null when the source does not state it. Never estimate.
'content' is the homepage copy, images and icons (Dashboard > Homepage content). Image values are theme files until replaced in WordPress.

scope.title: HT/LT Panels & Power Distribution
scope.text: Comprehensive solutions for high-tension (HT) and low-tension (LT) power distribution, including the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of HT/LT panels, capacitor panels, main distribution boards (MDBs), sub-main distribution boards (SMDBs), final distribution boards and associated protection and control equipment. Works include panel positioning and assembly, cable glanding and termination, earthing connections, circuit identification, functional checks and coordination with the approved electrical drawings and project specifications.

scope.title: Busducts & Rising Mains
scope.text:
Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of busbar trunking systems and rising mains for reliable power distribution in commercial, industrial and residential buildings. Equipment is sourced through authorised OEM channels and installed in accordance with approved general arrangement (GA) drawings, manufacturer recommendations and project specifications.

The work includes route coordination, setting out, installation of supports and hangers, busduct alignment and jointing, connection to transformers and switchgear, tap-off unit installation, earthing and bonding, and inspection of completed joints. Systems are checked for installation quality and electrical continuity before energisation, with testing and commissioning carried out in line with applicable requirements.

scope.title: Wiring & Cabling
scope.text:
Comprehensive installation of power and lighting wiring, as well as connections from distribution boards (DBs) to equipment. Works include cable route coordination, installation of conduits and cable supports, HT and LT cable pulling, dressing, securing, tagging and identification, followed by glanding and termination at panels, DBs and equipment.

Cable sizes and routes are coordinated with approved drawings and project specifications. Before energisation, connections are inspected and checked for continuity, insulation resistance, correct identification and secure termination to support safe and reliable operation.

scope.title: Critical Power & Equipment Connections
scope.text:
Installation and connection of UPS systems and battery banks to provide dependable backup power for critical loads. Works include electrical fit-outs for server and communication rooms, dedicated power supplies for air-conditioning units, and power connections for pumps, motors and other essential equipment.

Services cover coordination of equipment locations and power requirements, cable route preparation, installation of cable supports and containment, power and control cable laying, earthing and bonding, glanding, termination, and equipment connection. Where specified, UPS and battery works also include checking polarity, interconnections and installation clearances in line with manufacturer guidance.

Before energisation, installations are inspected and tested for insulation resistance, continuity, correct phase sequence, earthing and secure terminations. Final checks are coordinated with the equipment supplier and project team to support safe start-up and reliable operation in accordance with approved drawings and project specifications.

scope.title: Earthing, Surge & Lightning Protection
scope.text:
Installation of earthing and protective systems to help safeguard people, buildings and electrical equipment against electric shock, fault currents, lightning and transient voltage surges. The scope includes earth pits and electrodes, earthing grids, GI and copper conductors or strips, and bonding connections for panels, equipment, cable trays and other specified metallic services.

Lightning protection works may include air terminals, down conductors, test joints and connections to the earth termination network. Surge protection devices (SPDs) can be installed at designated distribution boards and equipment points, coordinated with the electrical system and the project design.

All components are installed to approved drawings, project specifications, manufacturer recommendations and applicable standards. On completion, the system is visually inspected and tested for conductor continuity and earth resistance. Test results are documented for handover and commissioning records.

scope.title: Electrical Containment Systems
scope.text:
Supply and installation of electrical containment to route and protect power, lighting and control cables throughout a building. The scope includes conduits installed within slabs, walls and floors; sleeves for cable and conduit penetrations; and back boxes for switches, sockets and other electrical accessories.

Cable management systems include GI cable trays, cable ladders, trunking and raceways, complete with bends, tees, reducers, couplers, covers, brackets, supports and other required fittings. Routes and containment sizes are coordinated with approved drawings, cable requirements, site conditions and other building services.

Installation includes setting out routes, fixing supports, maintaining alignment and clearances, providing access for future inspection and maintenance, and protecting cable routes at wall and floor penetrations. All works are completed in accordance with project specifications, manufacturer recommendations and applicable standards, ready for cable installation and subsequent inspection.

scope.title: Lighting, Switches & Electrical Accessories
scope.text:
Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of lighting systems and electrical accessories for commercial, industrial and residential projects. The scope includes indoor and outdoor LED luminaires, emergency and exit lights, and decorative light fixtures approved by the client and architect. Fixture selection and positioning are coordinated with the approved drawings and project requirements to achieve the specified illumination levels (lux levels).

Services also include lighting management and control systems, standard and industrial-grade switches and socket outlets, fans and junction boxes. Industrial-grade accessories are selected to suit the required application, location and equipment rating. Installation covers setting out, mounting, wiring, circuit connections, identification and coordination with other site services.

Completed works are inspected for secure installation and correct connections. Lighting circuits, switches, sockets, controls and emergency lighting functions are tested for proper operation in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications and applicable requirements.

scope.title: Electrical Testing & Commissioning
scope.text:
Testing and verification of electrical installations to confirm safe, reliable operation before handover. Services include insulation resistance (IR) and continuity testing, megger testing, circuit and polarity verification, panel load testing, and testing of HT/LT equipment.

Testing is carried out in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, equipment manufacturer recommendations and applicable standards. Results are documented to support commissioning, rectify identified issues and provide records for project handover.

scope.title: Fire Safety Systems
scope.text:
Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of systems supporting fire detection, alarm, emergency response and fire-fighting operations. The scope includes fire alarm and detection systems, emergency lighting and exit signs, dedicated power supplies for fire-fighting equipment, and gas suppression systems for LT panels, as specified in the project design.

Works include installation and connection of fire alarm panels, detectors, manual call points, sounders, visual alarm devices and associated cabling; emergency lights and exit signs; and power connections for fire pumps and other designated fire-fighting equipment. Gas suppression systems for LT panels include the specified detection and release components, control interfaces, and panel protection arrangements. Interfaces with other building systems are coordinated where required by the approved design.

All installations are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, manufacturer recommendations and applicable local fire safety regulations. Systems are inspected and functionally tested, including verification of device operation, alarm indications, emergency lighting, suppression system interfaces and power connections. Test results and commissioning records are prepared for handover.

deliver.heading: Project Methodology
deliver.sub: Five stages, from GFC review to handover, managed by our own project team.
deliver.insight: Approvals and long-lead equipment are planned first.
deliver.insight_em: Schedule risk is addressed before work begins on site.
deliver.panel1_items:
GFC drawings in hand before the kickoff meeting
Samples and technical data sheets approved within 5 days
Panel GA and shop drawings approved within one week
Ceiling layouts, IT power and raceway needs, and HVAC power loads confirmed up front
deliver.panel2_items:
LT panels
Light fixtures
Lighting management systems
Rising mains and busducts
deliver.panel2_note: Order placement, submittals and approvals are closed on a fixed timeline.

stages.title: Design
stages.text: We review the GFC drawings, then prepare shop and GA drawings to site conditions for approval by the PMC or consultant.

stages.title: Procurement
stages.text: Final quantities go to procurement alongside design. Vendors are validated and material is checked against the BOQ.

stages.title: Construction
stages.text: We secure the site, stage materials and carry out the works to approved drawings and method statements, under a risk assessment.

stages.title: Testing & commissioning
stages.text: Functional and visual checks, quality and safety inspections, and test reports from our own commissioning team.

stages.title: Handover
stages.text: As-built drawings, test reports and warranties. Snags are closed, the client’s team is trained, and a final walkthrough leads to sign-off.

quality.heading: Quality & Safety
quality.sub: Certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018, and run day to day by dedicated quality and safety staff.

quality_rows.text: QA requirements agreed with the client at the start of each project.
A quality control supervisor runs QA checks, reports non-conformities and works with client QA inspectors.
Work-type checklists kept current by the site team as execution progresses.
Every system tested, commissioned and signed off by the PMC or client.

safety_rows.text: An emergency response team on call 24/7.
Project safety reviews every alternate day, and a weekly safety report reviewed by top management.
HIRA risk assessments, height and hot-work permits, and lock-out tag-out before live connections.
Toolbox talks, PPE for every worker, monthly medical camps and tie-ups with local hospitals.
Statutory registers kept at every site under labour laws (labour licence, ESI and PF, Forms 9 to 19, leave and in-out registers), with a person assigned to maintain them.

company.heading: Company Profile
company.sub: An ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified electrical and fire safety contracting company, established in Hyderabad in 2008.

work_items.text:
Comprehensive Electrical and Fire Safety Services which includes
End-to-end solutions covering design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning.
Inspection and maintenance of electrical installations and fire safety systems, including annual maintenance contracts (AMCs).
Effective coordination with PMCs, architects, quantity surveyors, design consultants and builders to support seamless project execution.

End-to-end statutory liaising, drawings, and safety clearances from State wise Electricity Boards and CEIG.
• New LT/HT power sanctions, load enhancements, meter installations, transformer approvals, and name changes.
• CEIG Approvals: Statutory safety inspections, single-line diagram (SLD) approvals, high-tension (HT) installations, DG sets, and commissioning certification.

founder_photo.alt: Portrait of Abdul Kareem P, Managing Director of AAYKAY Electricals.

person2_photo.alt: Portrait of Shuaib A S, Director - Commercial & Procurement, AAYKAY Electricals.

company.person2_text:
With two decades of experience in the electrical contracting industry as Commercial and Procurement Professional.

Known for strong attention to detail, dependable supplier relationships, and effective coordination with project/accounts teams to support timely, cost-conscious operations.
company.paragraphs:
Established in 2008, AAYKAY Electricals Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified contractor specialising in electrical and fire safety services. We provide end-to-end expertise in design, supply, installation, testing, commissioning and maintenance.

Our commitment to quality, safety, responsive service and timely project delivery has earned the trust of leading multinational and Indian organisations. We have completed projects across banking, healthcare, manufacturing, data centres, IT parks, interior fit-outs, substations, commercial buildings and high-rise residential developments.

Our experienced project teams are supported by dedicated specialists in safety, quality, planning, procurement, design, tendering, billing, finance, human resources and administration—enabling us to deliver reliable solutions tailored to each project.
company.quote:
With 30 years in this field, across base builds, IT workspaces, laboratories, data centres, hospitals, industries, and commercial and high-rise buildings, I know how much a project depends on electrical work done right.

Since 2008, AAYKAY Electricals Private Limited has been committed to well-executed MEP works. Many of our clients have continued to work with us over the years, and most have become regular clients.

With the support of a dedicated team, AAYKAY has met challenge after challenge and reached new milestones. The journey continues, and with our team and our clients, I am confident the company will keep growing for years to come.

Merges with AayKay Electrical Enterprises. Branches follow in seven states.

roles.title: Project Manager – Electrical
roles.summary: Leads electrical projects from award to handover: planning, site teams, subcontractors, client coordination, quality, safety and billing.
roles.responsibilities:
Plan and run electrical works to the approved drawings, specifications and schedule
Lead project engineers, supervisors and subcontractors on site
Coordinate with the client, PMC, architects and consultants
Control material, manpower, cost and billing, and report progress to management
Ensure quality, safety and statutory approvals through testing, commissioning and handover
roles.requirements:
B.E./B.Tech in electrical engineering
10–15 years in electrical contracting, including project management
Experience of commercial, IT office, healthcare or high-rise projects
Sound knowledge of HT/LT systems, testing and commissioning

roles.title: Project Engineer – Electrical
roles.summary: Plans and executes electrical works on commercial, healthcare and IT projects, from shop drawings to handover.
roles.responsibilities:
Execute electrical works to approved drawings, method statements and the project schedule
Coordinate with the client, PMC, consultants and other services on site
Track material, manpower and progress, and report to the project manager
Carry out quality checks and support testing and commissioning
roles.requirements:
B.E./B.Tech or diploma in electrical engineering
3–6 years in electrical or MEP site execution
Working knowledge of AutoCAD and electrical drawings
Sound understanding of site safety practice

roles.title: Site Supervisor – Electrical
roles.summary: Supervises electricians and subcontractors on site, so that work is installed to drawings, safely and on schedule.
roles.responsibilities:
Allocate and supervise daily work of electricians and helpers
Check installations against drawings and checklists
Maintain site records, material stock and daily progress reports
Enforce PPE, permits and barricading on site
roles.requirements:
Diploma or ITI in electrical trade
5 or more years supervising electrical installation
Ability to read electrical layouts and single-line diagrams

roles.title: Safety Officer
roles.summary: Runs site safety on AAYKAY projects in line with ISO 45001:2018 and the client’s requirements.
roles.responsibilities:
Conduct safety inductions and toolbox talks
Prepare and review HIRA risk assessments and work permits
Inspect PPE, scaffolding, barricading and temporary electrical set-ups
Report incidents and prepare weekly safety reports
roles.requirements:
Diploma or certificate in industrial safety
2–5 years in construction site safety
Working knowledge of ISO 45001 and statutory safety requirements

roles.title: Design Engineer – Electrical
roles.summary: Prepares shop drawings, GA drawings and MEP coordination models for AAYKAY projects.
roles.responsibilities:
Prepare shop and GA drawings from GFC drawings
Coordinate MEP services in Autodesk Revit
Prepare quantity take-offs and technical submittals
Update as-built drawings at handover
roles.requirements:
B.E./B.Tech in electrical engineering
2–4 years in electrical design or drafting
Proficiency in AutoCAD and Autodesk Revit
